title: Ashvale Rising Revisited
author: Juniper Whitlock
blurb: Isandro Iversen, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
